verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Phaser's own MCP server, which Claude Desktop, Cursor and GitHub Copilot connect to. That is the server role, a different story, and cannot be credited here. Nothing shows Phaser Editor or the Phaser Game Agent acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers. Because Phaser ships an editor and a hosted agent, consuming MCP tools is a plausible capability, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
